ValidationRule.description: Allows TE user to close assignments on ongoing projects.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR( AND( IsChanged(pse__Status__c), ISPICKVAL( pse__Status__c , "Closed") ), IsChanged( pse__Closed_for_Time_Entry__c ), IsChanged( pse__Closed_for_Expense_Entry__c ) ), NOT($Permission.PM_Edit_Start_End_Dates ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( pse__Project__r.Project_Sub_Types__c , "IBS - Ongoing Work")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to close this Assignment.
